description: This class parses an XML SQL diff file (sqldiff.xml) within a JAR module, extracting versioned SQL statements to produce a sorted map based on module data.

classes.name: SqlDiffFileParser
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to parse SQL diff XML files within module JARs, retrieving versioned SQL statements into a sorted map.

methods.name: getSqlDiffs
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the sqldiff.xml from a module JAR to produce a sorted map of version-to-SQL statements.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Extracts text content of a specified tag from an XML element.

methods.name: validConfigVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported SQL diff configuration versions.

methods.name: getDiffNodes
methods.description: Gets the list of diff nodes matching the specified version from the XML root element.
